configure.title: Huwandu hwose
configure.description: Huwandu hwose husingamanikidzwe hwaunogona kutaura. Nekutaura huwandu hwose, sumu yezvikosho museries inofanira kuva huwandu uhwu kuti pie yakazara idhirowewe. Unogona kushandisa paramita iyi kudhirowa zvikamu zvepie chete kana machati egauge.

configure.title: Furatira Zvikosho Zvisina Chinhu
configure.description: Zvikosho zvisina chinhu zvichafuratirwa kuti zvidzivise kudhirowa zvimedu nemazita zvisingadiwi.

advanced.title: Kutsauka kweZita
advanced.description: Kutsauka kwenzvimbo yezita kubva panzvimbo yenguva dzose iri pahafu yechinhambwe cheradius. Kukosha uku kunogona kuva kwakanaka kana kwakaipa. Zvikosho zvakanaka zvichaisa zita kure nepakati.
